text:
maya: customer on Win webview + corp proxy hit sampleapp streaming corruption. seeing out-of-order fragments and occasional TextDecoder errors.
eli: any raw capture?
maya: trimmed server dump we captured: 
```
2026-03-24T08:12:01.000Z OUT chunk=\"data: {\\\"id\\\":1,\\\"seq\\\":0,\\\"text\\\":\\\"He\\\"}\\n\"
2026-03-24T08:12:01.001Z OUT chunk=\"data: {\\\"id\\\":2,\\\"seq\\\":0,\\\"text\\\":\\\"This is id2\\\"}\\n\"
2026-03-24T08:12:01.002Z OUT chunk=\"data: {\\\"id\\\":1,\\\"seq\\\":1,\\\"text\\\":\\\"llo\\\"}\\n\"
```
maya: proxy/http2 multiplexing caused interleaving so reader yielded id2 in between id1 fragments. sampleapp client just splits on "\\n\\n" and assumes read-order == logical order -> ends up emitting id2 before id1 reconstructed.
sam: that will also cause concat issues on reconnects if leftover bytes are merged. we should stop assuming read-order.
jonah: also seen UTF-8 split issue: proxies sometimes break multibyte codepoints across reads causing TextDecoder.decode to throw if not used in streaming mode.
eli: immediate fixes: 1) streaming-safe decoder (TextDecoder.decode(chunk, {stream:true}) + keep leftover bytes), 2) treat blank events (empty "\\n\\n") as no-ops, 3) parse event-level metadata (id+seq) when present and buffer fragments keyed by id until contiguous, 4) treat colon-prefixed comment markers like ":resume <token>" as explicit reset/reconcile points to avoid merging leftover chunks across auth-reconnects.
rachel: prototyped a mini-repro harness that shuffles chunks, injects extra CRLFs, and splits UTF-8 sequences mid-codepoint. naive client fails quickly.
sam: i'll author a small shared parser util: createOrderedSseParser({onEmit,onComment,opts}) with feed(bytes) and resetOnResume(token). it will streaming-decode, accumulate text, split raw events but then reassemble by id+seq when present, drop blank events, and expose diagnostic hooks. keep it opt-in for sampleapp first.
maya: please add logging when parser resets or sees resume tokens so we can correlate customer logs.
eli: add e2e tests: proxy-mock that injects CRLFs, shuffles interleaving, splits utf8, and simulates resume tokens. run across webview/chrome and node matrices. include a flaky-tolerance threshold.
ci-bot: queued: sampleapp-integration/webview-sse-reassembly (3 jobs).
devx-bot: created RDW-3102: "sse: reassembly for http2-multiplexed/proxy-split chunks + resume-safe parser" assigned to sam + rachel.
jonah: small short-term mitigation: debounce transient empty reads in webview path so we don't treat brief empty slices as disconnects; that reduces reconnect-merging frequency.
maya: customer provided a workaround (force http/1 or disable proxy compression) but wants upstream fix. i'll update them with the issue and ETA.
sam: will open PR today with parser util + unit tests + e2e harness + README blurb. aiming for minimal surface change and opt-in in sampleapp. :rocket:
